label: D2 after choosing a2 and reaching S1 by a rare transition, only in the last ~10 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (0 activations at D1/GO), with 99% of mass on steps where the agent chose a2 and the shown state is S1 (a rare a2->S1 transition), and only near episode end: 99% of activations are in ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80, and all coincide with the low-value bin (value head < 5.22, the end-of-episode drop). The good state, reward and stay/switch add nothing (restricting to good=S2 lowers F1). The a2->S1 rare predicate alone has 0.88 recall but 0.06 precision; adding the late-episode condition gives dev F1 0.75 / mass recall 0.93 (ep_trial>=90: F1 0.70, mass 0.96). Remaining false positives are late a2->S1 trials where it stays silent, and weak misses are a few a1->S1 or a2->S2 D2 steps late in the episode. Does not fire on a1->S2 rare transitions. All variables are observed at D2. I did not check what modulates magnitude.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over this trial (D2: a2 S1) and last trial (D2: a2 S2 u, a2 S1 u, a1 S1 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D2 & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=0.
